
This workflow is for analyzing the growth rates from high-throughput screens by performing statistical tests. 

The order of this workflow is: 
  1. Metadata
  2. Growth Rates Summary
  3. Repeated-Measures ANOVA & Linear Mixed-Effects Model 
  4. Lactose Data

Libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)      
library(broom)          
library(ggpointdensity) 
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(afex)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
```

load in the data 
```{r}
#sd_filtered= read.csv("output/filtered_data.csv")
growth_rates <-read.csv("input/Modeled_Data.csv") #phenotypic_gr_filtered
metadata <- read.csv("input/Strain_Metadata.csv")
```

Metadata 
Join the metadata and strain information, then order the carbon source columns 
```{r}
growth_rates_2 <- growth_rates %>%
  left_join(
    metadata %>% dplyr::select(Strain, Second_Substrate), 
    by = c("Strain" = "Strain")
  )  %>%
  mutate(
    # Set factor order: Control (Glucose) to increasingly complex carbon sources 
    Condition = factor(
      Condition,
      levels = c(
        "Glucose",               # Baseline Control / Hexose (C6)
        "Arabinose", "Xylose",   # Pentoses (C5)
        "Galactose",             # Hexose (C6)
        "Cellobiose", "Lactose", # Disaccharides (C12)
        "Pectin"                 # Polymer
      )
    )
  )
```

Growth Rates Summary
```{r}
#How many strains are isolated from each substrate? 
growth_rates_2 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Second_Substrate)) %>%
  distinct(Strain, Second_Substrate) %>%
  count(Second_Substrate, name = "n_strains") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_strains))

#Average Growth Rate on each Condition 
growth_rates_2 %>% group_by(Condition) %>% summarize(mean(Maximum.Growth.Rate))
growth_rates_2 %>% group_by(Condition,Second_Substrate) %>% summarize(mean(Maximum.Growth.Rate))


growth_rates_wide <- growth_rates_2 %>%
  dplyr::select(Strain, Condition, Maximum.Growth.Rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Condition,
    values_from = Maximum.Growth.Rate
  )

# Export directly to a CSV ready for Prism import
write.csv(growth_rates_wide, "output/growth_rates_wide.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

Repeated-Measures ANOVA & Linear Mixed-Effects Model 
```{r}
# Filter data and set factors
anova_test <- growth_rates_2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(Second_Substrate), 
         !Second_Substrate %in% c("Insect", "Lab")) %>%
  mutate(Strain = factor(Strain),
         Condition = factor(Condition),
         Second_Substrate = droplevels(factor(Second_Substrate)))

#Keep only complete cases (strains present in all 7 conditions)
complete <- anova_test %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Condition) == 7) %>%
  ungroup()

#Run the repeated-measures ANOVA
fit_cc <- aov_ez(
  id      = "Strain",
  dv      = "Maximum.Growth.Rate",
  data    = complete,
  between = "Second_Substrate",
  within  = "Condition"
)

fit_cc

#linear mixed-effects model 
lmem_growth_rates <- lmer(Maximum.Growth.Rate ~ Condition * Second_Substrate + (1 | Strain),
          data = anova_test)

anova(lmem_growth_rates)
```

Lactose Data 
```{r}
#filter down to the lactose data 
lactose_grouped <- anova_test %>%
  filter(Condition == "Lactose") %>%
  mutate(Substrate_Group = if_else(Second_Substrate == "Dairy", "Dairy", "Other"))

#t-test 
t.test(Maximum.Growth.Rate ~ Substrate_Group, data = lactose_grouped, var.equal = FALSE)

#Export Lactose Data 
# 1. Reshape lactose data into Wide Format (One column per Isolation Substrate)
lactose_wide <- lactose_grouped %>%
  group_by(Second_Substrate) %>%
  mutate(Strain_Index = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = Strain_Index,
    names_from = Second_Substrate,
    values_from = Maximum.Growth.Rate
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Strain_Index)

# 2. Export as CSV to import into Prism
write_csv(lactose_wide, "output/lactose_wide.csv")
```

```{r}
lactose_data= growth_rates_2 %>% filter(Condition == "Lactose" & !Second_Substrate %in% c("Insect","Lab"))

ggplot(lactose_data, aes(x = Second_Substrate, y = Maximum.Growth.Rate, fill = Second_Substrate)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Second_Substrate), 
    width = 0.2, 
    alpha = 0.6, 
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Lactose Divergence",
    x = "Isolation Substrate",
    y = NULL
  )

```
